name: Verify out-of-scope request is identified with escalation path
objective: Validate that the assistant clearly identifies out-of-scope requests and provides appropriate escalation paths.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Describe a request that is outside the assistant's capabilities
steps.testData: "What is the stock price of our company today?"
steps.expectedResult: Message is submitted to the assistant

steps.description: Verify the assistant identifies the request as out-of-scope
steps.expectedResult: The assistant clearly communicates that this request is outside its capabilities

steps.description: Verify appropriate escalation paths are provided
steps.expectedResult: The assistant suggests alternative channels or contacts for the request
